implemented_requirements.evidence: connect_four.py defines ROWS = 6, COLS = 7 and builds self.board as a 6×7 list of lists.
ConnectFour.current_player starts at 1 and switch_player() toggles between 1 and 2; cli.play() calls game.switch_player() after each valid move.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Players choose columns by typing a number
implemented_requirements.evidence: cli.read_column() reads input, validates it as a digit 1‑7, and returns a 0‑based column index.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Validate column choices (range and not full)
implemented_requirements.evidence: cli.play() calls game.is_valid_column(col) which checks 0 ≤ col < COLS and that the top cell is EMPTY; invalid choices produce a warning.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Drop a disc into the chosen column and update the board
implemented_requirements.evidence: ConnectFour.drop_disc(col) finds the lowest EMPTY cell in the column and places the current player's disc symbol.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display the board after each move
implemented_requirements.evidence: cli.play() prints game.display() each loop; ConnectFour.display() returns a string with column headers and rows.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect a win (horizontal, vertical, diagonal) and end the game
implemented_requirements.evidence: ConnectFour.check_win() scans every cell and four directions (0,1), (1,0), (1,1), (1,-1) using _line_from; cli.play() ends when a winner is returned.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect a draw when the grid is full and end the game
implemented_requirements.evidence: ConnectFour.is_full() checks that the top row has no EMPTY cells; cli.play() ends with a draw message when true.

judge.summary: All core Connect Four features are present: a 7×6 board, two alternating players, numeric column input with validation, disc dropping, board rendering, win detection in all directions, and draw detection. The code is syntactically correct and can be executed via main.py, so the implementation meets the benchmark.
